race.comment: KEMAL (12) seems to struggle beyond 1000m, and just battled on over 1100m last time out at Rockhampton. He was only beaten by a head here as the favourite when third here before that, and on a quick backup, he can get the job done this time. HERECOMESANTORINI (7) was trapped back and wide off a tough gate here last time out, and produced a run that is best overlooked. He was beaten by a nose here fresh up over this trip, and back to 1000m, he can make amends. Stick with him on an each-way basis. THE SOUR (10) ran some good races early in her last prep, and should be a lot stronger this season as a 5YO. A reasonable draw should see her settle in the right spot, and any market confidence will be worth following. RALOS STAR (8) has recently turned a corner with his form, and followed a fourth place finish with a last start second at Gatton by a neck. Keep him safe again. CAPIANA (9) ran on late here a month ago, and he starts from a better gate this time. Include.
